title: 36 Hours in San Sebastián
abstract: The first sight of the shimmering scallop-shaped bay will sweep you off your feet.

title: 36 Hours in San Sebastián, Spain
abstract: This city on the sea with lauded local cuisine can now also boast a spruced-up promenade, a renovated museum and a forthcoming culinary school.

title: 36 Hours in Marseille
abstract: Thanks to a waterfront renovation, a sleek new tram system, a first wave of design hotels and a generation of young restaurant and night-life impresarios, Marseille is looking better than ever.

title: 36 Hours in Marseille
abstract: First the bad news: Marseille is not Paris. Now the good news: Marseille is not Paris.

title: 36 Hours in Lower Manhattan
abstract: With the exception of those seeking a night of club-hopping, travelers hardly need venture north of Canal Street for a complete New York weekend.

title: 36 Hours in Downtown Manhattan
abstract: The financial district is bustling, Chinatown is as enticing as ever, and TriBeCa is bursting with new restaurants and bars — visitors hardly need venture north of Canal Street for a complete New York weekend.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Ore.
abstract: Portland is a small-scale metropolis with an outsize cultural footprint.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Ore.
abstract: Long noted for its bike culture and all things independent and artisan, in recent years the city has emerged as the capital of West Coast urban cool.
